changelog: 1.1.2: fixed a leaked socket + goroutine on every transport Stop() (a blocked read could keep a dead connection alive for up to a minute, and a handshake finishing after Stop() went live with nothing left to read it) - also fixes a node-wide connection-tracking leak on the exit-node side. 1.1.1: DNS resolver now refreshes from a new 'dns' host event instead of only at startup, so lookups stop timing out against a stale server list after roaming to a new network; socks5Udp explicitly declared false so hosts stop routing UDP/QUIC into this module; added pingWhileConnected; server-side transport/network code resynced with the current openflux-server fork.
